title: screening/<id>.yaml: a rejection that keeps its credit charge (SPEC §5.4.5, §11.15)
description: Only the public fields of a screening decision. A rejection is recorded here only when the ledger needs it, that is when the rejection cites a criterion under which the spend is not refunded (config.yaml credits.no_refund_criteria). The reason, the moderator and the automated scores are restricted (SPEC §11.15) and are never committed.

criterion.description: The numbered admission criterion the rejection cites (SPEC §8.4.3)

submitter.description: The account that submitted. An agent's spend is charged to its operator.
